items.title: Modern living room — mid brown palette
items.description: A modern living room palette sampled from the photo. Dominant notes: Mid brown (#93735f), Mid deep orange (#a98c79), Near-white orange (#f3f1ed), Rich deep orange (#634432). HEX values are averaged from pixels in the image, not invented.
items.alt: living room interior photo for a modern color palette
items.notes: Use #93735f on large planes (suggested wall/base). Pick the most saturated swatch for small accents only. #4a2b16 reads as a suggested dark contrast for frames, iron, or window bars. Roles are suggestions from share, lightness, and saturation — confirm on site with paint samples.

items.alt: living room interior photo for a modern color palette
items.notes: Use #134045 on large planes (suggested wall/base). Reserve #bfb5ab for textiles or a single architectural accent. A deep swatch grounds trim and metal. Roles are suggestions from share, lightness, and saturation — confirm on site with paint samples.
